name: Shattered Nightmare's
detailed_description:
After 15 years of service in the military, you return to your old childhood home, now abandoned and filled with distorted memories. As you attempt to restore the place, your daily tasks are quickly overshadowed by a dark presence that haunts the house. As night falls, you are thrown into a nightmare where your deepest memories intertwine with terrifying visions of an unresolved past.
Faced with a real threat and a mysterious intruder, you must navigate a maze of psychological horror and disturbing revelations. As you explore the echoes of your childhood, the terror is not limited to what lies within the house; your very sanity is tested. Will you be able to unravel the dark secrets that haunt your life or will you be forever trapped between the fragments of your worst nightmares?

What can we expect from the story?

After a long period of wars, pandemics and epidemics that decimated HALF of the world's population, the survivors decided to unite under a single nation. In the midst of this new world, an elite special force called [F.E.N.I.X. (Special Neutralization and Intervention Force X)] was created, composed of soldiers selected while still in childhood. These children were subjected to rigorous physical and psychological training and experiments, becoming super soldiers in charge of global defense.

Shattered Nightmare's is a psychological horror action game set in a pre-apocalyptic world, where the line between reality and insanity becomes increasingly blurred. With dynamic and intense gameplay, the game mixes the fast pace of the hack and slash style with brutal hand-to-hand combat and the use of heavy military weaponry.

In this dark universe, you take on the role of a protagonist marked by trauma and deep doubts about his identity and trust in his own allies. The narrative is centered on the character's personal development, as he faces external and internal horrors in a setting strongly inspired by Brazil.

Game highlights:

  • Psychological horror that challenges the player's sanity;

  • Frenzied combat with melee and firearm mechanics;

  • Switching between first and third person during gameplay;

  • HUD customization options for greater immersion;

  • Rich and detailed setting in a post-pandemic Brazilian setting;

  • A male protagonist with a dense and emotionally charged story.

Prepare for an intense experience, where every decision can affect your perception of reality and where your own fears can become your greatest enemy.

English, Portuguese - Brazil*
